reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM to confirm that Dock 38 is now her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups.

I don't have a way to save information between conversations, so I didn't tell her I'd remember it. I told her the DM itself is the record, and if she asks later in that DM I can look back and find it. She asked for no action, so I took none. I also told her I won't mention it in channels or in anyone else's conversation.
